description: This file defines models and logic for managing memberships, including partner membership states, membership lines, product modifications, invoice handling, and reporting views in an OpenERP/Odoo module.

classes.name: membership_line
classes.description: Model representing a membership line with validation and state computation.

classes.name: Partner
classes.description: Extension of res.partner to include membership-related fields and logic.

classes.name: product_template
classes.description: Extension of product.template to add a member price.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Extension of product.product to handle membership products and dynamic view loading.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: Extension of account.invoice to set cancel date on membership lines upon invoice cancellation.

classes.name: ReportPartnerMemberYear
classes.description: View model for yearly membership statistics.

classes.name: ReportPartnerMemberYearNew
classes.description: Alternate view model for yearly membership statistics.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of account.invoice.line to manage membership lines on create, write, and delete.

methods.name: _check_membership_date
methods.description: Checks if the membership product is not expired based on date.

methods.name: _state
methods.description: Computes the current state of a membership line based on invoice status.

methods.name: _get_partner_id
methods.description: Recursively retrieves partner IDs including associated members.

methods.name: _get_invoice_partner
methods.description: Recursively retrieves partner IDs from invoices including associated members.

methods.name: _membership_state
methods.description: Determines the current membership state of a partner.

methods.name: _membership_start
methods.description: Returns the start date of a partner’s membership.

methods.name: _membership_stop
methods.description: Returns the stop date of a partner’s membership.

methods.name: _membership_cancel
methods.description: Returns the cancel date of a partner’s membership.

methods.name: _get_partners
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all related partner IDs.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides copy method to reset membership lines.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Dynamically loads different views for membership products.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Sets cancel date on membership lines when invoice is canceled.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to manage membership lines on invoice line updates.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes associated membership lines when invoice lines are deleted.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates membership lines when new invoice lines are created for membership products.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates SQL views for yearly membership reports.
